name: Legionary Guard
background: Professional infantrymen stationed in Jerusalem. They view regional religious dynamics with cynicism until supernatural events force a change in perspective.

genericReactions.physical: I deal with what I can see and touch. What is this?
genericReactions.testimonial: I trust my own report, not the chatter of the crowds.
genericReactions.digital: That's above my rank. I follow orders.
genericReactions.environmental: I've seen things you wouldn't believe. The earth shaking... it was no normal tremor.
genericReactions.analytical: I count spears and shields, not... whatever this is.
genericReactions.prophecy: The local superstitions are not my concern. But what I saw... it was not normal.
